zh: 修复侧边栏删除或归档当前会话后意外退回主页面的问题：同步更新最近会话与已归档列表，并保持停留在当前列表视图，方便连续管理多个对话。
修复端内 WebView 打开工作台工具时误弹「需要重新登录」弹窗的问题：在页面脚本加载前注入同源 Cookie 与 localStorage/sessionStorage 登录态与租户上下文。
修复 Android 端在运营商屏蔽 188.114.* 或私有 DNS 仅返回不可达 IPv6 时登录请求超时的问题：引入支持 Google/AliDNS DoH 解析与可达 IPv4 优选的智能网络解析器。
en: Stay inside the active session list (Recent or Archived) after deleting or archiving a conversation instead of kicking back to the main chat screen.
Fix false "Re-login required" popups when opening workbench tools in iOS and Android WebViews by seeding origin-scoped localStorage, sessionStorage, and auth cookies before page scripts run.

Fix Android login request timeouts on networks where system/Private DNS returns unreachable IPv6 or blackholed 188.114.* edge IPs by adding DoH (8.8.8.8 / 223.5.5.5) resolution and clean IPv4 prioritization.
